newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mosaix started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mosaix started at buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage of Mosaix Inc with a buy rating and estimated earnings per share of $1.07 in 1997 and $1.35 in 1998.

-- Mosaix is a software developer that was formed from the merger of Digital Systems International and Viewstar Corp. Mosaix sells and supports call center systems and business process applications software.

-- In a statement, Hambrecht & Quist said the post-merger company should provide "attractive, comprehensive customer management solutions" as its combined products begin to roll out in a controlled and steady manner in 1997.
